description: Optional typed context for an error. Fields are additive and only populated when the error can safely expose that context to API clients.

endpointId.description: Port OS endpoint ID involved in the failed dispatch.

pluginId.description: Port OS plugin ID that reported the failure.

pluginRouteId.description: Plugin-owned route identifier involved in the failed dispatch.

provider.description: Third-party provider or bridge name that reported the failure.

directive.description: Message namespace and name or provider directive that failed.

parameter.description: Request parameter or capability value that caused the failure.

actual.description: String representation of the submitted value when the plugin can safely report it.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Suggested retry delay for rate-limit or provider-unavailable failures.

correlationId.description: Provider or plugin correlation ID useful for support.

providerCode.description: The third-party provider's own error code, for support. It is opaque and provider-specific; branch on `code` and `family` instead.

correlationToken.description: Token that correlates an outcome-unknown dispatch with its eventual result.

fieldErrors.description: The request fields that were rejected, when the error is about the request's content.
